_doc: UI strings the Cheburnezia fork overrides. Read by generate_ts.py, see branding/translations.cmake.
Each entry selects upstream messages by exact 'source' or by 'source_startswith', optionally
narrowed to one 'context' (QML file name or C++ class). Placeholders: {app} is
Text per language: an explicit key ('en', 'ru_RU', ...) wins, then 'all'. An explicit 'en'
means the message was reworded, so languages without their own key get the 'en' text.
Otherwise the existing translation (or, for English, the source) gets 'AmneziaVPN' /
'Amnezia' replaced by {app}; names like AmneziaWG and AmneziaDNS are left alone.
An untranslated message gets the English text.
Only messages where Amnezia means THIS app are listed. AmneziaWG, AmneziaDNS, Amnezia
Premium/Free, the vpn:// config format and the Amnezia containers on the server are
Amnezia's products and keep their names.
